already_known_before_this_protocol: Derm7pt J0 prior-corrected construct sensitivity outcomes
not_permitted_before_formal_freeze: any D1 diagnosis prediction or aggregate
any D1 full-joint held-out concept likelihood
outcome_exposure_boundary.manifest_limitation: The freeze script proves named-file hashes and absence of named result paths; it cannot prove a person's outcome exposure.

dataset.official_test_policy: QUARANTINED; its index file may be read only to assert exclusion, but no test feature, concept, diagnosis, prediction, score, or aggregate may be returned or used

inner_probe.unit: case within each meta-fit set A=outer_train\H
inner_probe.purpose: inside each meta-fit A=outer_train\H, produce probe OOF scores using probes trained wholly inside A so T_A can be fitted without any path from H

calibration.semantic_role: held-out meta folds, not a second independent rowwise calibration split
calibration.purpose: for each held-out meta fold H, set A=outer_train\H; create inner probe OOF scores only inside A, fit T_A only on those prior-corrected A scores and C_A, then use a full-A probe, the full-A empirical prior, and T_A to predict H
calibration.outer_validation_calibrator: concatenate the raw H predictions made by each full-A probe and their rowwise full-A generating priors, recompute the corrected top-level strict meta-OOF table, and fit one T_full per concept on that table plus outer-train C; a full-outer-train probe is used only to predict outer validation, where its scores are corrected by the full-outer-train prior before applying T_full

single_case_perturbation_invariance.condition: for any h in held-out meta fold H, keep X and all split assignments fixed and perturb C_h and/or Y_h

splitting.overlap_policy: every case must occur in exactly one outer-validation fold per repetition and, when in outer train, exactly one held-out meta fold; any upstream fit that generates a held-out H marginal must exclude all of H

concept_probe.sample_weight: inverse-frequency within exactly the probe fit rows

prior_correction.strict_meta_oof: a row in H uses the prior of the full-A probe that predicts H, where A=outer_train\H; the inner OOF rows used to fit T_A each use their own generating probe-fit prior inside A
prior_correction.outer_validation: uses the empirical concept prior of the full outer-train probe fit

concept_calibration.input: already probe-fit-prior-corrected probability scores generated under held-out meta-fold isolation

joint_model.name: CF_MPJC
joint_model.family: rank-one centered full-joint interaction followed by one-way-marginal I-projection
joint_model.optimizer: L-BFGS-B with analytic implicit I-projection gradient
joint_model.start_construction: zero, constant +0.15, alternating +/-0.15, then deterministic Normal(0,0.15) with RNG seed 7319
joint_model.selection_across_starts: lowest outer-train penalized concept joint NLL only
joint_model.ipf_failure_policy: raise if the final target-energy projection does not reach 1e-11 within 3000 total dual updates accumulated across all continuation stages; no per-stage cap reset, silent retry, solver switch, or tolerance relaxation

ipf_solver_contract.statistical_target: the unchanged one-way-marginal I-projection defining CF-MPJC

result_blind_numerical_verification.role: implementation-correctness evidence only; neither a method innovation nor empirical performance evidence

joint_model.null: phi exactly zero equals the independent Cartesian product
joint_model.fit_information: outer-train strict held-out-meta-fold calibrated marginals and gold concepts C only

diagnosis_interface.gold_task_model: L2 diagnosis-balanced logistic regression fitted on outer-train gold concept one-hot vectors
diagnosis_interface.p_y_given_c_table: evaluate the outer-train gold task model on all 972 Cartesian concept states
diagnosis_interface.primary_inference: exact matrix sum p(y|x)=sum_c q_phi(c|x) p(y|c) over all 972 states

controls.INDEPENDENT_MARGINALIZATION: same calibrated marginals and same p(Y|C) table; exact sum under the independent product
controls.UNPROJECTED_RANK1_JOINT: same rank-one centered interaction, same concept-only fit inputs, L2, optimizer budget, calibrated marginals, and exact task marginalization; normalize the tilted product without I-projection
controls.JOINT_MAP: same CF-MPJC q_phi and p(Y|C), but pass only the maximum-probability concept state
controls.MARGINAL_MEAN_PLUGIN: apply the gold-concept diagnosis model directly to the concatenated calibrated marginal means
controls.OOF_SOFT_LOGISTIC: diagnosis-balanced L2 logistic head trained on outer-train strict held-out-meta-fold calibrated marginals
controls.OOF_HARD_LOGISTIC: same as OOF_SOFT_LOGISTIC after blockwise argmax one-hot conversion

BILINEAR_SCORE_HEAD.description: diagnosis-balanced rank-one bilinear logistic head on Helmert-reduced calibrated score blocks

controls.GOLD_TO_HARD_PRED: outer-train gold-concept diagnosis head evaluated on outer-validation blockwise-argmax concept predictions
controls.GOLD_ORACLE: outer-train gold-concept diagnosis head evaluated on outer-validation gold concepts
controls.DIRECT_X: diagnosis-balanced L2 logistic regression on the frozen image embedding, C=1.0 and max_iter=2000

prediction_contract.probabilities: float64 simplex probabilities; clipping is allowed only inside log scoring and not in saved predictions
prediction_contract.paired_comparison: all models must predict the same cases, repetitions, outer folds, and labels

concept_prediction_contract.unit: case x repetition x concept x state
concept_prediction_contract.audit_purpose: permit independent row-state recomputation of probe-fit prior correction and scalar-temperature calibration

runtime_guard.failure_policy: raise before analysis and before atomic publication

fit_manifest_contract.projection_diagnostics_source: ProjectionDiagnostics returned by the validation marginal-preserving projection
fit_manifest_contract.projection_iteration_identity: sum(joint_projection_stage_iterations) == joint_projection_iterations; the length equals stages on success, while an exhausted global cap may stop before all planned stages

serialization_contract.json_standard: RFC 8259 compatible JSON; NaN and positive/negative Infinity are prohibited

analysis.repeated_cv_risk: retain every case x repetition prediction; calculate each repetition's risk first and then average the five repetition risks with equal weight; never average probabilities produced by different outer-training sets before scoring
analysis.primary_diagnosis_estimand: for each repetition, diagnosis-class-macro mean paired true-class log-probability gain, followed by an equal-weight mean across five repetitions; positive favors CF-MPJC
analysis.concept_estimand: held-out gold full-concept-state log-likelihood gain averaged over repetitions within case, then over cases
analysis.diagnosis_bootstrap: cluster-resample case IDs within diagnosis class, retain all five repetitions for every sampled case, calculate the paired macro statistic within each repetition, then average repetitions
analysis.concept_bootstrap: cluster-resample case IDs and retain all repetitions; average the paired gain across repetitions within case
analysis.ece_binning: equal-width top-label confidence bins on [0,1], with cases weighted to an equal diagnosis-class prior inside each repetition
analysis.tail_metric: within each diagnosis class and repetition, fractional-boundary CVaR of the worst 10% case NLL mass, then equal-average diagnosis classes and repetitions
analysis.interval_rule: G1-G5 use paired two-sided 90% bootstrap interval lower bounds; noninferiority passes at equality with -0.005 nats.
analysis.multiplicity_boundary: The ECE-or-CVaR reliability gate is an exploratory development-screen union and is not multiplicity-controlled confirmatory inference.

gate_validity_preconditions.failure_effect: the D1 gate is invalid and overall PASS is prohibited; bilinear nonconvergence is a strong-control validity failure, not a new performance threshold

success_gates.G1_full_joint_concept: CF-MPJC minus independent held-out full-concept log-likelihood gain has paired 90% LCB > 0
success_gates.G2_diagnosis_joint_value: CF-MPJC minus INDEPENDENT_MARGINALIZATION diagnosis macro true-class log-probability gain has paired 90% LCB > 0
success_gates.G3_exact_marginalization: CF-MPJC minus JOINT_MAP diagnosis macro true-class log-probability gain has paired 90% LCB > 0
success_gates.G4a_oof_soft_noninferiority: CF-MPJC minus OOF_SOFT_LOGISTIC diagnosis gain has paired 90% LCB >= -0.005 nats
success_gates.G4b_bilinear_noninferiority: CF-MPJC minus BILINEAR_SCORE_HEAD diagnosis gain has paired 90% LCB >= -0.005 nats
success_gates.G5_reliability_or_tail: either equal-diagnosis-prior top-label ECE10 improvement or fractional-boundary class-balanced CVaR-10% NLL improvement has paired two-sided 90% bootstrap LCB > 0 against both OOF_SOFT_LOGISTIC and BILINEAR_SCORE_HEAD

G6_distributed_benefit.top_10_percent_net_gain_share: <= 0.80; top 10% is selected within each diagnosis class with a fractional boundary under the equal-class-prior target

success_gates.near_neighbor_attribution: UNPROJECTED_RANK1_JOINT is a mandatory fully paired report and marginal-preservation ablation; no extra pass threshold is introduced beyond the author-approved D5 gates.
success_gates.initial_success_label: PASS only if all validity preconditions and G1 through G7 pass; otherwise FAIL_WITH_COMPONENT_DIAGNOSIS_REQUIRED or INVALID_GATE_EVALUATION when a validity precondition fails

second_task_boundary.requirement: A separately preregistered explicit-medical-concept task must test the frozen method direction before external confirmation.
second_task_boundary.cbis_ddsm: DEVELOPMENT_EXPOSED_ONLY; it may be used for method-frozen directional replication if its concept/data contract passes, but never as fresh confirmation.
second_task_boundary.fresh_confirmation: not named, selected, opened, or scored by this D1 protocol

failure_interpretation.G1_fail: pairwise J0 structure did not transport to a held-out full joint; stop MPJC and do not add rank or choose edges from diagnosis results
failure_interpretation.G1_pass_G2_fail: joint concept structure is real but not diagnosis-useful under this task interface; retain only the mechanism finding
failure_interpretation.G3_fail: exact task marginalization is not an effective component; remove that method claim
failure_interpretation.G4_or_G5_fail: the structured posterior lacks evidence of advantage over strong discriminative capacity controls; do not advance it as a Pattern Recognition main method
failure_interpretation.G6_fail: benefit remains concentrated in a small catastrophic tail; do not call it a distributed handoff solution
failure_interpretation.G7_fail: treat as a numerical or implementation failure; only a result-blind correctness repair may precede a rerun under a new hash manifest
failure_interpretation.gate_validity_fail: if any bilinear fit or validation projection is nonconverged, the concept artifact audit fails, or any JSON artifact is non-finite/non-standard, label the gate evaluation invalid and prohibit PASS; do not count control nonconvergence as performance evidence
failure_interpretation.second_task_fail: treat Derm7pt as a dataset-specific result; do not open a fresh external set to rescue the method

freeze.verification_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_mpjc_joint_core.py tests/test_mpjc_calibration.py tests/test_mpjc_bilinear_baseline.py tests/test_mpjc_near_neighbor.py tests/test_mpjc_analysis.py tests/test_mpjc_pilot.py tests/test_derm7pt_quarantine_loader.py tests/test_mpjc_freeze.py

prohibited: select, return, train on, predict, score, or summarize any Derm7pt official-test row; the test index may be read only to enforce exclusion from the development cohort
use diagnosis Y in concept calibration, joint fitting, rank choice, regularization choice, start selection, or IPF settings
change concepts, folds, repetitions, rank, regularization, controls, metrics, gates, or failure interpretation after observing D1 outcomes
select edges, ranks, or models on outer-validation outcomes and evaluate on the same cases
claim patient-level independence, external validity, clinical utility, safety, LLM benefit, curriculum benefit, or fresh confirmation
use private spine or another sealed dataset to tune or rescue D1
overwrite a freeze manifest or result directory
